extName.message: TubeMind: AI Summary, Transcript Search & Notes for YouTube

extDescription.message: Search inside YouTube videos, get free on-device AI summaries, take timestamp notes and stay focused. Private.

aboutText.message: TubeMind is free. It is financed by small, clearly marked sponsor tips inside the extension and by voluntary donations – never by selling your data.

welcomeText.message: Three things that make YouTube more useful:

welcomeStep1.message: Press S while a video is playing. Every match appears as a yellow marker on the progress bar.

welcomeStep2.message: Press N for a note or B for a quick bookmark. Everything lands in your library.

welcomeStep3.message: Click the TubeMind icon → Side panel → Summarize video.
